Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two distinct MS approaches: a shotgun DDA-like discovery phase (processed via MaxQuant LFQ) and a targeted PRM phase for low-abundance proteins. The primary enrichment is iPOND, which is a proximity-based capture of proteins on nascent DNA, mapping most closely to an AP-MS or proximity-labeling style modifier (mod_ap_ms) in the provided ontology list, although it is specifically a DNA-protein interaction assay.

scope: we coupled the iPOND (isolation of proteins on nascent DNA) technique with targeted mass-spectrometry analysis
This strategy enabled the isolation of DNA fragments containing newly incorporated EdU and associated proteins
The eluted proteins were analyzed by immunoblotting or mass spectrometry (MS).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was isolated using the iPOND technique, which captures proteins associated with nascent DNA (replisomes) via click chemistry and streptavidin capture, fitting the definition of an affinity-purified complex.
